mapper.sql: -- 불변 승인 metadata만 합친다. 삭제된 작업/원문과 조인하거나 당시 건수를 현재 성공으로 바꾸지 않는다. SELECT a.id AS action_id,a.batch_id,'APPLICATION'::text AS action_kind,a.action_code,a.expected_version AS accepted_from_version, a.preview_id,a.scope_item_count,a.selected_item_count AS approved_target_count,a.deleted_item_count AS deleted_count_at_acceptance, NULL::integer AS approved_eligible_count,NULL::integer AS approved_base_reopen_count,NULL::integer AS approved_confirmation_restore_count, NULL::integer AS cancelled_pending_count,a.created_at AS accepted_at FROM announcement_attachment_batch_application_actions a WHERE a.batch_id=#{batchId} AND a.expected_version<#{throughVersion} UNION ALL SELECT a.id AS action_id,a.batch_id,'ROLLBACK'::text AS action_kind,'START'::varchar AS action_code,a.expected_version AS accepted_from_version, NULL::uuid AS preview_id,a.scope_count AS scope_item_count,a.target_count AS approved_target_count,a.deleted_count AS deleted_count_at_acceptance, a.eligible_count AS approved_eligible_count,a.base_reopen_count AS approved_base_reopen_count,a.confirmation_restore_count AS approved_confirmation_restore_count, a.cancel_pending_count AS cancelled_pending_count,a.created_at AS accepted_at FROM announcement_attachment_batch_rollback_actions a WHERE a.batch_id=#{batchId} AND a.expected_version<#{throughVersion}
mapper.select: -- 동일 REPEATABLE READ와 버전 상한으로 전체 승인 수를 센다. 페이지 제한을 전체 수에 적용하지 않는다. SELECT count(1) FROM () history

-- 버전 순서가 시계 변경보다 우선한다. 최초 조회 상한을 유지해 후속 승인으로 페이지가 밀리지 않게 한다. SELECT action_id,batch_id,action_kind,action_code,accepted_from_version,preview_id,scope_item_count,approved_target_count, deleted_count_at_acceptance,approved_eligible_count,approved_base_reopen_count,approved_confirmation_restore_count,cancelled_pending_count,accepted_at FROM () history ORDER BY accepted_from_version DESC,action_kind DESC,action_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
